scientific_target.question: Can a frozen method predict auditory-evoked population spike-rate trajectories in held-out animals on verified shared anatomical regions/depth bins, using stimulus/timing alone or the same inputs plus permitted prior neural history?
scientific_target.known_answer: Independently measured held-out response counts divided by the actual bin exposure and eligible recorded-unit denominator, in spikes/s/source-unit on a frozen region/depth schema. A CSD trajectory is a separately declared outcome with separate units, never pooled with spike-rate error.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Official recording-bearing Garcia archives001419/001420/001421 and original NWB2.7.0 spike timestamps. Complete001421 metadata verifies26 files and2,053 declared source clusters, with666 anatomically unassigned; source methods and schema support deposited spike-event identity. Actual observation coverage and eligible regional denominators remain unresolved. Anatomy-only001344 does not supply the response target.
scientific_target.case_unit: One complete held-animal stimulus trial with fixed response-bin and anatomical support masks; no per-unit correspondence between animals is presumed.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Animal, grouping all sessions and cross-archive aliases; channels/units/trials are nested measurements.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Cross-animal response prediction only after anatomy and observed exposure are verified. The present runtime manifest alone does not establish that inference; public source exposure also prevents an unseen-data claim by default.
exclusions: Treating deposited spike-event counts as a physiologically qualified rate without justified observation exposure and eligible source-cluster denominator; the spike-event identity itself is supported by source methods and exact NWB2.7.0 semantics.
Treating anatomy-only archives or seven archives as independent cohorts.

primary.name: Animal-macro mean squared population spike-rate trajectory error (prospective physiological target; manifest-only declared metric)
primary.aggregation: Within each held animal, average squared error over predeclared eligible trial×region/depth×time bins using fixed support; then equal animals. If spike rates are authenticated, units are (spikes/s/eligible source-unit)^2.
primary.rationale: Preserves the delivered manifest’s animal_macro_mse primary and animal_macro_mae companion without implying a delivered numerical scorer. The prospective physiological response definition adds required units/exposure/anatomical authentication; CSD needs a separately frozen scale and scorer.

secondary: Animal-macro mean absolute error, preserving the manifest’s animal_macro_mae companion; physiological units require the same target authentication.
Per-animal and per-region/depth error and support/coverage; retain absent anatomical bins explicitly.
Paired timing-only versus history-augmented error on the identical query universe.
Separately reported CSD error only after verified units, corresponding depth and complete exposure.

comparators.name: Training population mean trajectory
comparators.inputs: Training animals only, same stimulus and frozen shared anatomical schema.
comparators.procedure: Proposed fixed stimulus-conditioned mean response; support masks and fallback for unseen stimulus/region fixed before query.

comparators.name: Timing-only versus history regression
comparators.inputs: Identical stimulus/timing metadata, with prior neural history added only in the declared second arm.
comparators.procedure: Proposed fixed ridge baseline: training-only feature scaling, alpha grid [0.01,0.1,1,10,100] selected by animal-grouped validation MSE, with nonnegative output clipping fixed before query. Timing-only and history-augmented variants use identical targets and splits; this comparator must be implemented and qualified before evaluation.

nuisance_controls: Establish complete observation windows through unit observation intervals or another authenticated continuous-recording duration, clock and unit-support bridge. An absent optional obs_intervals field alone is not disqualifying; absent events, click-pulse stops, image clocks or first/last spikes cannot substitute for coverage evidence.

Preserve the authenticated NWB2.7.0 seconds/reference-time semantics for deposited spike events. Justify acquisition-stimulus clock alignment through source-bound common-clock evidence, validated conversion or another defensible acquisition bridge; exact original converter byte parity is not mandatory. Physical observation exposure remains a separate requirement.

Use actual source unit-to-contact anatomical labels. Preserve666 blank assignments and distinguishMGv/MGd/MGm/MZMG/BIC/SG; a broadMGN probe label is insufficient. Literal contact coordinates lack a verified origin/frame and must not be automatically scaled into anatomical depth. Define eligibility without selecting on evaluation responses.
Keep trial boundaries and full filter/lag support outside scored future bins; compare recording density and missing-depth patterns across animals.
evaluation.uncertainty: Bootstrap or summarize paired errors by biological animal after cross-archive identity reconciliation; five declared query animals would limit inference even if authenticated. Do not treat1010trials or20bins as independent animal replication.
evaluation.failure_policy: Do not score until authentic case IDs, units, time exposure and target masks are bound. Require one finite trajectory per exact case/support bin; reject duplicates, omissions, extra cases and undefined normalization. Missing anatomy is declared support, not silently dropped favorable cases.

Its nominal released-event-rate title does not verify physiological rate units or the canonical region/depth trajectory target.
